title: rhynchospora subfiliformis

This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
